Additional Stan  CORAM:
 JUSTICE K.R. MOHAPATRA  JUSTICE SAVITRI RATHO
ORDER  Order No. 26.09.2025  03. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
2. Petitioner in this writ petitioner prays for the following relief:

" It is therefore most humbly and respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to issue Rule NISI calling upon the opposite parties show cause as to why i. The order dtd.20.02.2025 at Annexure-8 shall not be quashed;
ii.
The dispute arising out of Land acquisition shall not be referred to the Authority for determination of compensation and to extent the benefits available U/ R & R Policy. 2006.
If the opposite parties fail to show cause or show insufficient cause, the Rukle may be made absolute.

entities.text: Sankar Chandra Biswas vs State Of Odisha And Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: And for this act of kindness, the petitioner as in duty bound shall ever pray."

3. It is submitted by Ms. Das, learned counsel for the Petitioner that the matter was adjourned on 12th August, 2025 to enable the Petitioner to file an application for amendment of the writ petition.
She submits that the writ petition requires exhaustive amendment.
Hence, she prays for withdrawal of the writ petition seeking liberty to file a fresh one with better particulars.

Designation: Junior Stenographer Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA, CUTTACK Date:
26-Sep-2025 14:56:17
4. A memo in support of her submission is filed in Court, which is taken on record.
5. Hence, this writ petition is disposed of as withdrawn with a liberty to file a fresh one with better particulars within a period of one month.
6. Certified copy of the document(s), if any filed, be returned to learned counsel for the Petitioner on substitution of attested photocopy thereof.
(K.R. Mohapatra)

Judge  (Savitri Ratho)
